questions.content: A certain orbital has n = 4 and m<sub>L</sub> = <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.186ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.76ex" height="1.505ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -583 778 665" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="2212" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2212"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>3. The number of radial nodes in this orbital is ____________. (Round off to the Nearest Integer).
questions.explanation:
Number of radial nodes = n – – 1

n = 4, mL =–3 so = 3

radial nodes = 4 – 3 – 1 = 0
